annotations.title: Show a monitor and what it collected

description:
Purpose: Show one monitor with its counts and a page of the postings it collected; a posting can be old while still hiring.
When: The user asks what a monitor found. monitor_review_widget_render shows its newest postings as a list, and job_postings_search_widget_render shows search postings instead.
Cost: About 3440 tokens for 20 postings.

state.description: Which of the monitor's postings to show; default is the ones not yet applied to or skipped.

name: monitor_get

outputSchema.description: One monitor with one page of its postings in one state.

companies.description: Companies the monitor keeps; empty for the whole market.

applied.description: The triage state over ALL of those postings (found and family alike), so New + Applied + Skipped == FoundTotal + FamilyTotal.

familyTotal.description: The postings matched in the family lane, under the same cap. FoundTotal and FamilyTotal partition every posting the monitor holds.

foundTotal.description: The postings matched in the exact and title lanes, under the monitor's per-user cap.

new.description: The triage state over ALL of those postings (found and family alike), so New + Applied + Skipped == FoundTotal + FamilyTotal.

skipped.description: The triage state over ALL of those postings (found and family alike), so New + Applied + Skipped == FoundTotal + FamilyTotal.

createdAt.description: When the monitor was saved, in UTC.

datePosted.description: How recently a kept posting was published.

department.description: The department the monitor narrows to.

slug.description: The department slug the department field takes.

employmentType.description: The employment type the monitor keeps.

excludeKeywords.description: Words that drop a posting whose title or text carries one.

experienceLevel.description: The experience level the monitor keeps.

id.description: The monitor id the other monitor tools take.

includeFamily.description: True when the role's wider family is watched too.

includeNoSalary.description: True when postings without a salary are kept.

keywords.description: Words a kept posting's text carries.

locations.description: The locations the monitor watches, as resolved.

salaryCurrency.description: The currency code that labels the monitor.

titleText.description: The title the monitor watches: the resolved role's name, or the words given.

postings.description: The postings of this page, most recently collected first.

department.description: The department the posting's role belongs to.

slug.description: The department slug the department field takes.

employmentType.description: The employment type, in the employmentType field's vocabulary.

experienceLevel.description: The experience level, in the experience field's vocabulary.

id.description: The posting id to pass to job_postings_get_full_description.

locationCount.description: How many locations the posting names in total.

locations.description: Up to five location names of the posting.

matchedVia.description: Which match found the row: exact, title or family.

postingUrl.description: The company's own posting, where the user applies.

publishedAt.description: When the company published the posting.

currency.description: The currency code the amounts are in.

period.description: The time the amounts cover, such as year or hour.

shortDescription.description: A one-line digest of the duties and skills, in the company's words.

title.description: The job title as the company wrote it.

workFormat.description: Where the work happens: remote, hybrid or on-site.

state.description: The state the postings below are in.

total.description: How many postings the monitor holds in this state.

totalIsCapped.description: True when the count stopped at its cap and more postings are in this state.

totalPages.description: How many pages this state fills.

title: Show a monitor and what it collected
